cards.label: Capstone
cards.title: Blue Belt Test
cards.md:
Three tests: one rehearsed, two live. Each has pass criteria you can observe.

| Test | Setting | Observable pass criteria |
|---|---|---|
| 1. The read | A 10-minute conversation with a trusted friend, a colleague you trust, or Claude role-playing a counterpart with a hidden need | Baseline noted in the first minute. Conversation type named. One need hypothesis written, then checked back in the conversation and confirmed or corrected. At least one label followed by a full pause. |
| 2. Office dojo, live | One real work conversation where someone holds a position that blocks you | You name or answer the concern under the position before you argue your own. You check back at least once. Your own ask still made (White Belt rules hold). |
| 3. Personal dojo, live | One real initiation | You go first with a ping, respect the answer, and, if the ping is returned, propose a specific next meeting yourself |

cards.label: Capstone
cards.title: Blue Belt Test
cards.md:
**debriefPrompt.** Which read was wrong and how you found out; which conversation type you most often mis-match; what your contact log shows about who you go first with and who you still wait for.

**ready.** **You're ready for Brown Belt** when all three tests pass, your hypothesis cards show the habit of checking (not a perfect hit rate), and your contact log shows you going first regularly.

**artifacts.** Blue Belt artifacts you carry forward: baseline cards, hypothesis cards, position-versus-need matrix, accusation audits, boundary sentences, contact log.

cards.label: Evidence
cards.title: Blue Belt Evidence
cards.md:
- Baselines taken
- Reads checked back (right / revised)
- Labels with a full pause
- Conversation type matched
- Initiations
- Pings returned
